$comment: Read-only export of the Figma library via use_figma (Plugin API). Regenerate with design-system/figma-export.js. Do not edit by hand.

components.name: Button
components.description: Button — src/components/ui/button.tsx: Button (variant, size), or buttonClassName() for Base UI triggers. Variant: secondary (default, .ui-control), primary (.ui-primary; white in dark mode, never mid-grey), danger (destructive confirm), danger-ghost (Empty Trash). Size: md = 40px dialogs and panels (px 16, text-sm medium); toolbar = 44px library top bar (padding set by the caller: ps-3 pe-4 with a leading icon). Code also has lg = 44px page actions with px 16. Base UI triggers use buttonClassName(). Pill shape via the components-layer control-shape rule (999px + superellipse(1.5)). Press: scale(0.96) over --motion-quick. Disabled: --opacity-disabled (0.6). Focus: 1px border-focus outline, 2px offset.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: IconButton — src/components/ui/button.tsx: IconButton (size, aria-label), or iconButtonClassName() for Base UI triggers. Control sizes: sm 32px, md 40px (dialog close), lg 44px (top bar). Base UI triggers use iconButtonClassName(). Media chrome = .library-card-media-chrome: 32px translucent surface over card media with a 12px squircle radius; 44px hit target via 6px slop. Always pair with an aria-label and a 350ms tooltip. Disabled: --opacity-disabled. Wrap in Tooltip (src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx) with describe={false} when the tooltip repeats the aria-label; never add a native title.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: SegmentedControl — src/components/ui/segmented-control.tsx. Two-choice switch (role=group with an accessible label; each choice aria-pressed). Variant=Icon: 44px raised track, 2px inset, two 42px icon buttons with Tooltips (library Grid/List, note Edit/Preview). Variant=Text: track height follows --viewer-control-size (44px default), options split the width with text-xs medium labels (viewer Fit/Scroll, PDF Pages/Scroll, note format, gallery Slides/Scroll). The .ui-selected thumb (bg-active + 1px inset highlight) slides over --motion-glide with --ease-standard; selected text-primary, idle text-secondary.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Library top-bar search (#library-search, type=search, .ui-field inside .library-top-bar). 40px pill with superellipse(1.5) corners, bg-control, 1px border-control. 16px Search glyph at 14px, text inset 40px. Empty shows the shortcut hint (10px kbd, text-secondary). Filled swaps the hint for a 44px clear target with a 28px round hover surface (bg-raised). While a content search is pending, the glyph becomes a 16px spinner after 200ms. Focus: 1px border-focus outline inset 2px. Placeholders: "Search your library…", "Search collections…", "Search tags…", "Search Trash…".

components.name: TextField
components.description: TextField — src/components/ui/text-field.tsx (fieldClassName() for bare inputs). Label (text-sm medium, text-primary) above the input with an 8px gap; the label is the input’s accessible name, and an optional hint below is linked with aria-describedby. Input: .ui-field, min-h 44px, px 12px, text-sm, bg-control, 1px border-control, radius-control-md (13px). Placeholder text-secondary. Focus: 1px border-focus outline inset 2px. Touch devices render 16px text to avoid zoom.

components.name: ScrollTextarea
components.description: Multi-line .ui-field (ScrollTextarea). Same surface as Text field; padding 12px, text-sm, min-h 160px, resize-y. Scrollbar uses the shared overlay track; it never reserves a gutter.

properties.name: Value
properties.default: Keep the details worth returning to.

components.name: RadioCard
components.description: RadioCard — src/components/ui/radio-card.tsx. A full-width radio option: the whole card is the label, so its text is the radio’s accessible name. .ui-control surface (bg-control, 1px border-control) with 12px × 16px padding and a 12px gap; the checked option takes bg-active. Pill shape from the shared control-shape rule (999px with superellipse(1.5)) in every dialog — link conflict, bookmark import and delete collection; don’t override the radius per dialog. Label text-sm medium; optional description text-xs secondary. The radio is the native input (16px, nudged 4px to the first text line).

properties.name: Description
properties.default: Items already in a Keepall collection stay where they are.

components.name: Menu item
components.description: menuItemClassName() — src/components/ui/menu-item.ts, on Base UI Menu.Item / Select.Item / ContextMenu.Item. Shared surface: .ui-menu-item flex w-full text-sm; tone default (text-primary, bg-active highlight) or danger (text-danger, bg-danger highlight); layout row (icon + label, items-center gap-2). In select popups (.shell-select-option) rows are min 28px (40px on touch), padding 4px 8px, 13px; radius = popup radius − 6px inset − 1px with squircle corners; one gliding highlight (MenuHoverList) follows pointer and keyboard. Optional 18px leading icon, tabular count (text-xs, text-secondary) and a 16px checkmark slot.

components.name: Menu
components.description: .ui-popover + .ui-menu-popup: bg-control, 1px border-control, radius-panel (20px) with squircle corners, 6px inset, shadow-menu. Width ≥ max(9rem, trigger width); height capped at the available height. Select popups (role=listbox) scroll in the registry ScrollArea because the listbox sits inside its viewport. Action menus (role=menu: card, row and bulk actions) scroll in a native ui-scrollbar container so the menu owns its menuitems directly. Opens on the fast motion tier: fade + 4px slide toward the trigger + scale(0.96 → 1); exits on fast-exit. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltip — src/components/ui/tooltip.tsx (TOOLTIP_CLASS; TooltipContent when a Select trigger composes its own Root). radius-control-sm, 1px border-control, bg-surface, padding 6px 10px, text-xs medium, shadow-menu, 8px from the trigger. Delay 350ms for toolbar controls, 100ms for folder and tag previews. Set describe=false when the text repeats the trigger’s accessible name so it isn’t announced twice. Never use a native title attribute on a control. Panel-style previews (note excerpt, long title) pass unstyled with their own .ui-popover surface.

components.name: Toaster
components.description: Sonner toast (.kc-toast): bg-surface, 1px border-control, 12px radius, 14px / 1.6 text, shadow-menu. For background results only — Trash undo uses the Undo notice in the top bar instead.

components.name: UndoNotice
components.description: Transient Trash undo. Lives ONLY in the library top bar action slot (LibraryTopBar `notice` prop) — never inside the scrolling content. 40px control-squircle surface (bg-control, 1px border-control, 2px inset, 12px start padding), text-xs secondary message, 32px Undo (medium, text-primary) and Dismiss buttons with bg-raised hover. A 2px timer runs along the bottom; the notice withdraws after 6s, pauses on hover, focus, busy or a hidden tab, and stays until dismissed after a failed undo. Enters with a 4px rise over the moderate tier.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: ConfirmDialog — src/components/ui/confirm-dialog.tsx. .ui-popover with no padding, max-width 28rem, radius-panel. Header (a div, not a header element, so the library top bar stays the only banner landmark): title (text-xl semibold) + description (text-sm relaxed, text-secondary), 40px close IconButton; 1px border-control divider. Body: optional content, error (text-sm text-danger, role=alert), then right-aligned Cancel (Button secondary) and confirm (Button danger). Initial focus on Cancel. While busy the confirm label becomes the pending label, both actions are disabled at --opacity-disabled, and pointer dismissal is off. Opens on the slow tier: fade + scale(0.97 → 1) over a blurred .ui-backdrop.

properties.name: Description
properties.default: 3 items will move to Trash. You can restore them from Trash until you empty it.

components.name: Sidebar nav item
components.description: Library sidebar row — ShellNavItem / ShellNavLink in src/app/library-shell.tsx. Desktop 36px rows (40px+ on touch), text-sm, text-secondary; 40px icon column with an 18px glyph, 8px gap, 12px end padding; 11px tabular count (hidden on row hover while the row menu shows). Hover bg-raised. Active (aria-current="page") = .ui-selected: bg-active + 1px inset top highlight, font-medium, and text-primary for the label, icon AND count (classes merged with cn so the active color wins; keeps 4.5:1 on bg-active). Collapsed rail keeps only the 40px icon column and shows the label in a Tooltip to the right — never a native title. Pill radius with superellipse(1.5); press scale(0.98). Focus: 1px border-focus outline at offset −1px.

components.name: Sidebar section header
components.description: Collapsible Collections / Tags section toggle ([data-sidebar-section-toggle], CollapsibleSection in library-shell.tsx): 36px, text-primary medium label, chevron rotates when the section closes. In the collapsed rail it shows its label in a Tooltip. Sections are spaced 12px apart on desktop; open state persists per section in localStorage.

components.name: SettingsLink
components.description:
Full-width link row with a trailing arrow that leads to another settings section or page.


import { SettingsLink } from "@/app/settings/settings-link";

components.name: ItemTypeBadge
components.description: ItemTypeBadge (card variant): one colored identity glyph on the .library-card-media-chrome surface, bottom-end of the preview at 14px inside the media. 32px high, min 32px wide, 16px glyph. Colors use item/ — darker in light mode, the brighter item/on-media/ in dark mode. Only image galleries add text (the count, before the glyph). role="img" with an aria-label naming the type; color is never the only cue.

components.name: LibraryCardMetadata
components.description: .library-card-metadata-pill (LibraryCardMetadata). Collection pill sits left, tag-count pill right; each is its own button. 32px, 8px horizontal padding, 6px icon gap, bg-raised, text-xs text-secondary, pill radius with superellipse(1.5). Hover bg-active + text-primary; press scale(0.96). Pill edges sit 16px from the card edge so the folder glyph aligns with the 24px content inset. Folder and tag-preview tooltips open after 100ms.

components.name: LibrarySelectionControl
components.description: LibrarySelectionControl: 32px media-chrome checkbox at the card’s top-start corner (center 38px from the card edges, 44px hit target). Appears on hover, keyboard focus, or while a selection is active. State=Selected uses action-primary with text-on-action.

components.name: CardNote
components.description: CardNote: personal note or image caption. Note glyph (plain text) or MD glyph (Markdown) in item-note color, then one truncated 13px line in text-primary. 24px row with an expanded hit area, 8px after the source row. Only render when there is content; it opens the Keepall item.

properties.name: Note
properties.default: Try the quiet corner next to the tall window.

components.name: CardSource
components.description: CardSource: external source host for links and images. 11px favicon centered in a 16px slot, host in 11px / 16px text-card-meta, always followed by the external-arrow glyph. Local filenames use the same text without the arrow.

components.name: Library card
components.description: Grid card (.library-card). bg-card, 64px squircle outer curve with an 8px inset; the media keeps the concentric 56px curve, a 1px border-media inner outline and native proportions (PDF covers: intrinsic ratio, never fixed). Footer: 16px side padding (content at 24px), 10px top, 12px bottom, 6px row gap; title 16px medium/22px, one line (two for link cards without an OG image); Card source (11px), Card note (13px). Collection pill left, tag pill right, 16px from the card edge; 2px extra outer bottom padding. Corner controls (selection top-start, actions top-end) are 32px media-chrome surfaces 14px inside the media, centres 38px from the card edges; they appear on hover/focus or during selection. Type badge bottom-end. Selected: bg-selected and an action-primary checkbox. Masonry columns ≥ 320px with 20px gaps.

components.name: List row
components.description: List view row (.library-list-row). Min 64px, 8px inset, 28px control-squircle radius; 48px media slot with a 20px radius (outer − inset). Title 14px medium; secondary line 3px below: 20px type glyph in a 24px slot, then source, caption, note excerpt or distinct filename (12px / 18px, text-secondary). Collections and tag count on the right (LibraryCardMetadata); narrow rows show only glyphs. Hover/focus bg-control; selected bg-selected. Selection (16px from the start, over the thumbnail) and actions (12px from the end) are 32px pills that appear on hover/focus. The title link covers the whole row. Rows sit 4px apart in up to three 440px-min columns.
